entities.name: Wen
entities.description: Mara's pottery teacher at Clay & Co

memories.summary: Mara took up pottery as a deliberate non-screen, non-patient distraction to cope with the stress of her mother and night shifts, valuing that for two hours she didn't think about afib, Epic, or work.
Mara bought matcha on 2026-04-12 to cut down on coffee, though she was skeptical the habit would last.
Mara tends to frame her own coping efforts as 'silly' or doomed to not stick (pottery, matcha), downplaying things she does for herself.
Mara noted her pottery teacher Wen said she grips the clay too hard, and reflected that it was 'probably a metaphor' for how she holds tension.
